feeds.title: Law Of The Land
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Patricia Salkin. Law of the Land blog is on land use law and zoning. It is designed to provide a forum for the discussion of current laws, policies, and decisions that affect the use of land. It highlights new court decisions, new state and federal laws and policies, and actions at the local government level that guide and/or impact land use and community development.

feeds.title: Penn State Center For Agricultural And Shale Law
feeds.description: Our website shares articles on agricultural law. Penn State Law research and outreach activities with a specific focus on those issues of importance in Pennsylvania. Through its programs, the Center serves a wide variety of stakeholders including agricultural producers, landowners, and more.

feeds.title: Farm Bill Law Enterprise Blog
feeds.description: Read timely analysis of proposed legislation on our Blog. Farm Bill Law Enterprise is a national partnership of law schools working toward a farm bill that reflects the long-term needs of our society.

feeds.title: Texas Agriculture Law Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Texas Ag Law Blog. The goal of this blog is to keep you up to date on various legal issues impacting Texas agriculture. This blog is an outreach project of the Texas AgriLife Extension Service. We are specifically focused on water law, oil and gas law, leasing, property rights, right to farm statutes, and landowner liability.

feeds.title: Cape Law Firm PLC » Agriculture
feeds.description: This segment of our website features articles on agricultural laws. Cape Law Firm PLC was built to serve the people and businesses in the Ag sector. It's one thing to advise clients about the law it is another thing entirely to understand how the law plays out in your business.

feeds.title: Ohio Agricultural Law Blog
feeds.description: Our blog page contains posts on farms, food, animals, land, resources, etc. This blog is an outreach project of the Agricultural & Resource Law Program at The Ohio State University, a program supported by OSU Extension.

feeds.title: Janzen Schroeder Ag Law Blog
feeds.description: Janzen Ag Law is a law firm focused on serving those involved with agriculture, including expanding and sophisticated farms, ag technology providers, and agribusinesses. Janzen Ag Law was founded in 2015 as a law firm dedicated to serving the needs of farmers, ag technology providers, and agribusinesses.

feeds.title: The LL.M. Program in Agricultural & Food Law
feeds.description: A blog about agricultural & food law issues, including sustainability & resiliency in the LL.M. Prog at the University of Arkansas School of Law. It was founded 40 years ago. It leads the nation in this important area of law, connecting lawyers to our food system, from farm to plate.

feeds.title: National Agricultural Law Center » The AG and Food Law Update
feeds.description: This section of our blog shares the ag and food law updates. The National Agricultural Law Center is a unit of the University of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture and serves as the nation's leading source of objective, scholarly, and authoritative agricultural and food law research and information, serving public and private sector stakeholders.

feeds.title: Center for Agricultural Law And Taxation
feeds.description: The Center shares timely, objective, unbiased information to producers, professionals, and agribusinesses concerning the application of important developments in agricultural law and taxation. CALT was established in 2006, it serves as a primary source of professional educational training in agricultural law and taxation.

feeds.title: LawBlogs.ca » Land & Agriculture
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles exclusively on Land and Agriculture. LawBlogs.ca is the home of The Canadian Law Blogs list, an open directory of Canadian blogging lawyers, law librarians, marketers, IT professionals, and paralegals.

feeds.title: Farm Law And Ag Law Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm John Schwarz, I'm a third-generation farmer and an agricultural law attorney. This farm knowledge allows me to better serve farm clients. When you need help with an ag/farm matter, it makes sense to have a farming attorney help you.

feeds.title: Agricultural Law and Taxation Blog
feeds.description: Agricultural Law and Taxation Blog is a part of the Law Professor Blogs Network, contains approximately 130 detailed and fully annotated articles annually, and is the most widely read agricultural law and taxation blog online.

feeds.title: Horak.Attorneys-At-Law » Agricultural Law
feeds.description: This particular segment of our blog shares articles on agricultural laws and policies. Horak Attorneys-at-law advises and represents clients in all legal matters concerning the production or distribution of foodstuffs/cosmetics and consumer goods.
